infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the Sydney Royal Easter Show
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run on all nine routes each day during the Sydney Royal Easter Show from Thursday 2 to Monday 13 April 2026.  
  
Travel on the Major Event Buses is included in the cost of tickets to the Easter Show. No need to tap on and off, simply show your Easter Show ticket to the driver when boarding buses.   
  
Buses run every 10 to 20 minutes from early morning until around 2.30pm each day during the Show. 
  
Please note that timetables vary on weekdays and weekends and are subject to traffic conditions.  
  
Return buses will start leaving Olympic Park from 2pm each day, with the last bus leaving at 10.30pm each night. Additional buses will operate on Friday 3 April for fans attending the NRL game at Accor Stadium and on Thursday 9 April (Seniors Day), return buses start leaving Olympic Park from 1pm. 
  
For more information on transport options to the event including detailed bus timetables, see the Royal Easter Show event page.

urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the Sydney Royal Easter Show
content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run on all nine routes each day during the Sydney Royal Easter Show from Thursday 2 to Monday 13 April 2026.  
  
Travel on the Major Event Buses is included in the cost of tickets to the Easter Show. No need to tap on and off, simply show your Easter Show ticket to the driver when boarding buses.   
  
Buses run every 10 to 20 minutes from early morning until around 2.30pm each day during the Show. 
  
Please note that timetables vary on weekdays and weekends and are subject to traffic conditions.  
  
Return buses will start leaving Olympic Park from 2pm each day, with the last bus leaving at 10.30pm each night. Additional buses will operate on Friday 3 April for fans attending the NRL game at Accor Stadium and on Thursday 9 April (Seniors Day), return buses start leaving Olympic Park from 1pm. 
  
For more information on transport options to the event including detailed bus timetables, see the Royal Easter Show event page.
subtitle: Major Event Buses operating for the Sydney Royal Easter Show

infoLinks.urlText: Olympic Park diversions during the Sydney Royal Easter Show
infoLinks.content:
From 4am until last service on Thursday 2 April school bus services in Olympic Park will be using different stops and routes while roads are closed in the precinct for the Sydney Royal Easter Show.  
 
Stops on Park Street at Olympic Park Station and on Dawn Fraser Avenue will be closed 
 
Routes 665s, 760s and 761s will use a temporary stop on Dawn Fraser Avenue at Park Street near the train station (212799). 
  
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. For more information on transport to the event and service changes, see the Sydney Royal Easter Show event page.
